"use client";

import {
  ArrowDown01Icon,
  Cancel01Icon,
  CpuIcon,
} from "@hugeicons/core-free-icons";
import { HugeiconsIcon } from "@hugeicons/react";
import type { FileUIPart, LanguageModelUsage, UIMessage } from "ai";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { CSSProperties, PointerEvent } from "react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type ContextWindowKind =
  | "system"
  | "tools"
  | "files"
  | "conversation"
  | "memory"
  | "other"
  | "reserved";

export interface ContextWindowItem {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  tokens: number;
}

export interface ContextWindowSegment {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  /** Picks the color. Defaults to `id` when it names a kind, otherwise `other`. */
  kind?: ContextWindowKind;
  /** Defaults to the sum of `items`. */
  tokens?: number;
  /** Parts of the segment, such as attached files. Each owns its share of cells. */
  items?: readonly ContextWindowItem[];
  /** Marks the count as an estimate. Shown with a leading `~`. */
  approximate?: boolean;
}

export interface ContextWindowCell {
  segment: string;
  item?: string;
  kind: ContextWindowKind;
}

const KINDS: readonly ContextWindowKind[] = [
  "system",
  "tools",
  "files",
  "conversation",
  "memory",
  "other",
  "reserved",
];

const isKind = (value: string): value is ContextWindowKind =>
  KINDS.some((kind) => kind === value);

const cleanTokens = (tokens: number | undefined): number =>
  tokens !== undefined && Number.isFinite(tokens) ? Math.max(0, tokens) : 0;

const sumTokens = (values: readonly number[]): number => {
  let total = 0;
  for (const value of values) {
    total += value;
  }
  return total;
};

export const contextWindowKind = (
  segment: ContextWindowSegment
): ContextWindowKind => {
  if (segment.kind) {
    return segment.kind;
  }
  return isKind(segment.id) ? segment.id : "other";
};

export const segmentTokens = (segment: ContextWindowSegment): number => {
  if (segment.tokens !== undefined) {
    return cleanTokens(segment.tokens);
  }
  return sumTokens(
    (segment.items ?? []).map((item) => cleanTokens(item.tokens))
  );
};

const trimDecimal = (value: number): string => {
  const rounded = Math.round(value * 10) / 10;
  return Number.isInteger(rounded) ? String(rounded) : rounded.toFixed(1);
};

/** `842`, `4.2K`, `200K`, `1.2M`. */
export const formatTokens = (tokens: number): string => {
  const value = Math.round(cleanTokens(tokens));
  if (value < 1000) {
    return String(value);
  }
  if (value < 999_950) {
    return `${trimDecimal(value / 1000)}K`;
  }
  return `${trimDecimal(value / 1_000_000)}M`;
};

export const contextWindowTotals = (
  segments: readonly ContextWindowSegment[],
  maxTokens: number
) => {
  const max = cleanTokens(maxTokens);
  const used = sumTokens(segments.map(segmentTokens));
  return {
    free: Math.max(0, max - used),
    max,
    over: Math.max(0, used - max),
    ratio: max > 0 ? used / max : 0,
    used,
  };
};

/** Largest remainder: whole shares of `total` that add up to exactly `total`. */
const apportion = (weights: readonly number[], total: number): number[] => {
  const sum = sumTokens(weights);
  if (sum <= 0 || total <= 0) {
    return weights.map(() => 0);
  }
  const quotas = weights.map((weight) => (weight / sum) * total);
  const shares = quotas.map((quota) => Math.floor(quota));
  const order = quotas
    .map((quota, index) => ({ index, rest: quota - Math.floor(quota) }))
    .toSorted(
      (left, right) => right.rest - left.rest || left.index - right.index
    );
  let left = total - sumTokens(shares);
  for (const { index } of order) {
    if (left <= 0) {
      break;
    }
    shares[index] = (shares[index] ?? 0) + 1;
    left -= 1;
  }
  return shares;
};

/** A segment that holds any tokens keeps one cell, taken from the largest share. */
const keepVisible = (shares: number[], sizes: readonly number[]): number[] => {
  const next = [...shares];
  for (const [index, size] of sizes.entries()) {
    if (size <= 0 || (next[index] ?? 0) > 0) {
      continue;
    }
    const donor = next.indexOf(Math.max(...next));
    if ((next[donor] ?? 0) > 1) {
      next[donor] = (next[donor] ?? 0) - 1;
      next[index] = 1;
    }
  }
  return next;
};

/**
 * Lays the segments out over `count` cells in reading order. Each cell is the
 * segment (and item) it belongs to, or `null` for free space. When the
 * segments overflow `maxTokens`, they share the whole field.
 */
export const contextWindowCells = (
  segments: readonly ContextWindowSegment[],
  maxTokens: number,
  count: number
): (ContextWindowCell | null)[] => {
  const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(count));
  const { free, used } = contextWindowTotals(segments, maxTokens);
  const sizes = segments.map(segmentTokens);
  if (used <= 0) {
    return Array.from({ length: total }, () => null);
  }
  const shares = keepVisible(apportion([...sizes, free], total), sizes);
  const cells: (ContextWindowCell | null)[] = [];
  for (const [index, segment] of segments.entries()) {
    const kind = contextWindowKind(segment);
    const items = segment.items ?? [];
    const itemSizes = items.map((item) => cleanTokens(item.tokens));
    const rest = Math.max(0, (sizes[index] ?? 0) - sumTokens(itemSizes));
    const parts = apportion([...itemSizes, rest], shares[index] ?? 0);
    for (const [partIndex, size] of parts.entries()) {
      const item = items[partIndex]?.id;
      for (let cell = 0; cell < size; cell += 1) {
        cells.push({ item, kind, segment: segment.id });
      }
    }
  }
  while (cells.length < total) {
    cells.push(null);
  }
  return cells.slice(0, total);
};

/** About four characters per token. Good enough to split a measured total. */
export const estimateTokens = (text: string): number =>
  Math.ceil(text.length / 4);

export interface ContextWindowSource {
  /** `messages` from `useChat`. */
  messages: readonly UIMessage[];
  /**
   * Usage of the last step (the `finish-step` part, not `totalUsage`). Its
   * input and output tokens are what the model now holds, so estimates are
   * scaled until the segments add up to it.
   */
  usage?: Pick<LanguageModelUsage, "inputTokens" | "outputTokens">;
  /** The system prompt, or its token count. */
  system?: string | number;
  /** Tool definitions, or their token count. */
  tools?: number | Record<string, unknown>;
  /** Memory text, or its token count. */
  memory?: string | number;
  /** Exact tokens for a file part. Without it, files are estimated. */
  fileTokens?: (file: FileUIPart) => number;
  /** Replaces the four-characters-per-token estimate. */
  estimate?: (text: string) => number;
}

const IMAGE_TOKENS = 1600;

const estimateFileTokens = (file: FileUIPart): number => {
  if (file.mediaType.startsWith("image/")) {
    return IMAGE_TOKENS;
  }
  const comma = file.url.indexOf(",");
  if (!file.url.startsWith("data:") || comma === -1) {
    return 0;
  }
  const payload = file.url.length - comma - 1;
  const bytes = file.url.slice(0, comma).endsWith(";base64")
    ? (payload * 3) / 4
    : payload;
  return Math.ceil(bytes / 4);
};

const stringify = (value: unknown): string => {
  if (value === undefined) {
    return "";
  }
  if (typeof value === "string") {
    return value;
  }
  try {
    return JSON.stringify(value) ?? "";
  } catch {
    return "";
  }
};

const measure = (
  value: string | number | Record<string, unknown> | undefined,
  estimate: (text: string) => number
): { tokens: number; exact: boolean } => {
  if (typeof value === "number") {
    return { exact: true, tokens: cleanTokens(value) };
  }
  return { exact: false, tokens: estimate(stringify(value)) };
};

const readMessages = (
  messages: readonly UIMessage[],
  estimate: (text: string) => number,
  fileTokens: (file: FileUIPart) => number
) => {
  const files: ContextWindowItem[] = [];
  let conversation = 0;
  for (const message of messages) {
    for (const [index, part] of message.parts.entries()) {
      if (part.type === "text") {
        conversation += estimate(part.text);
      } else if (part.type === "file") {
        files.push({
          id: `${message.id}-${index}`,
          label: part.filename ?? part.mediaType,
          tokens: cleanTokens(fileTokens(part)),
        });
      } else if (
        part.type === "dynamic-tool" ||
        part.type.startsWith("tool-")
      ) {
        const input = "input" in part ? part.input : undefined;
        const output = "output" in part ? part.output : undefined;
        conversation +=
          estimate(stringify(input)) + estimate(stringify(output));
      }
    }
  }
  return { conversation, files };
};

const scaleSegment = (
  segment: ContextWindowSegment,
  factor: number
): ContextWindowSegment => {
  const items = segment.items?.map((item) => ({
    ...item,
    tokens: Math.round(item.tokens * factor),
  }));
  return {
    ...segment,
    items,
    tokens: Math.round(segmentTokens(segment) * factor),
  };
};

/** Scales the estimated segments so everything adds up to `target`. */
const calibrate = (
  segments: ContextWindowSegment[],
  target: number
): ContextWindowSegment[] => {
  const exact = sumTokens(
    segments.filter((segment) => !segment.approximate).map(segmentTokens)
  );
  const estimated = sumTokens(
    segments.filter((segment) => segment.approximate).map(segmentTokens)
  );
  if (estimated <= 0 || target <= exact) {
    return segments;
  }
  const factor = (target - exact) / estimated;
  const scaled = segments.map((segment) =>
    segment.approximate ? scaleSegment(segment, factor) : segment
  );
  const drift = target - sumTokens(scaled.map(segmentTokens));
  const largest = scaled
    .filter((segment) => segment.approximate && !segment.items)
    .toSorted((left, right) => segmentTokens(right) - segmentTokens(left))
    .at(0);
  if (!largest || drift === 0) {
    return scaled;
  }
  return scaled.map((segment) =>
    segment === largest
      ? { ...segment, tokens: Math.max(0, segmentTokens(segment) + drift) }
      : segment
  );
};

/**
 * Builds segments from AI SDK chat state. Text and tool calls count as
 * conversation, file parts become the files segment. Pass the last step's
 * `usage` to pin the total to what the provider measured.
 *
 * @example
 * const { messages } = useChat<MyMessage>();
 * const usage = messages.at(-1)?.metadata?.usage;
 * <ContextWindow
 *   maxTokens={200_000}
 *   segments={contextWindowSegments({ messages, system: 3100, usage })}
 * />
 */
export const contextWindowSegments = ({
  messages,
  usage,
  system,
  tools,
  memory,
  fileTokens,
  estimate = estimateTokens,
}: ContextWindowSource): ContextWindowSegment[] => {
  const read = readMessages(
    messages,
    estimate,
    fileTokens ?? estimateFileTokens
  );
  const systemSize = measure(system, estimate);
  const toolsSize = measure(tools, estimate);
  const memorySize = measure(memory, estimate);
  const segments: ContextWindowSegment[] = [
    {
      approximate: !systemSize.exact,
      id: "system",
      label: "System prompt",
      tokens: systemSize.tokens,
    },
    {
      approximate: !toolsSize.exact,
      id: "tools",
      label: "Tools",
      tokens: toolsSize.tokens,
    },
    {
      approximate: !fileTokens,
      id: "files",
      items: read.files,
      label: "Files",
    },
    {
      approximate: true,
      id: "conversation",
      label: "Conversation",
      tokens: read.conversation,
    },
    {
      approximate: !memorySize.exact,
      id: "memory",
      label: "Memory",
      tokens: memorySize.tokens,
    },
  ];
  const present = segments.filter(
    (segment) => segment.id === "conversation" || segmentTokens(segment) > 0
  );
  if (usage?.inputTokens === undefined) {
    return present;
  }
  return calibrate(present, usage.inputTokens + (usage.outputTokens ?? 0));
};

export interface ContextWindowClassNames {
  root?: string;
  header?: string;
  summary?: string;
  field?: string;
  cell?: string;
  legend?: string;
  row?: string;
  item?: string;
  footer?: string;
}

export interface ContextWindowProps {
  segments?: readonly ContextWindowSegment[];
  /** Size of the model's context window, in tokens. */
  maxTokens?: number;
  /** Model id shown in the header. */
  model?: string;
  title?: string;
  /** Number of cells in the field. */
  cells?: number;
  /** Cells per row. Defaults to 40, or 25 when the card is narrow. */
  columns?: number;
  /** Share of the window, 0 to 1, from which the percentage turns red. */
  warnAt?: number;
  /** Segments whose items start expanded. Defaults to all of them. */
  defaultOpen?: readonly string[];
  /** Rendered only when passed, so a transcript can stay read-only. */
  onRemoveItem?: (segmentId: string, itemId: string) => void;
  /** Rendered only when passed. Cells shimmer until the promise settles. */
  onCompact?: () => void | Promise<void>;
  /** Forces the compacting state, for compaction the server started. */
  compacting?: boolean;
  compactLabel?: string;
  /** Rendered only when passed. */
  onClear?: () => void;
  clearLabel?: string;
  className?: string;
  classNames?: ContextWindowClassNames;
  /** Handy for overriding the --context-window-* theme vars inline */
  style?: CSSProperties;
}

  "grid-cols-[repeat(25,minmax(0,1fr))] @xs/context-window:grid-cols-[repeat(40,minmax(0,1fr))]";

const SWEEP_MS = 400;
const FREED_MS = 4000;

const ENTER_CLASS =
  "fade-in-0 slide-in-from-bottom-2 animate-in fill-mode-both duration-300 ease-out motion-reduce:animate-none";

const KIND_COLOR: Record<ContextWindowKind, string> = {
  conversation: "var(--context-window-conversation)",
  files: "var(--context-window-files)",
  memory: "var(--context-window-memory)",
  other: "var(--context-window-other)",
  reserved: "var(--context-window-reserved)",
  system: "var(--context-window-system)",
  tools: "var(--context-window-tools)",
};

const HATCH =
  "bg-[repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,var(--context-window-reserved)_0,var(--context-window-reserved)_1.5px,transparent_1.5px,transparent_3px)]";

interface ActiveTarget {
  segment: string;
  item?: string;
}

const isLit = (
  cell: ContextWindowCell | null,
  active: ActiveTarget | null
): boolean => {
  if (!active || !cell) {
    return true;
  }
  if (cell.segment !== active.segment) {
    return false;
  }
  return active.item === undefined || cell.item === active.item;
};

const percentLabel = (ratio: number): string => {
  const percent = Math.round(ratio * 100);
  if (percent === 0 && ratio > 0) {
    return "<1%";
  }
  return `${percent}%`;
};

const tokensLabel = (tokens: number, approximate: boolean | undefined) =>
  `${approximate && tokens > 0 ? "~" : ""}${formatTokens(tokens)}`;

const statusLabel = ({
  compacting,
  free,
  freed,
  over,
}: {
  compacting: boolean;
  free: number;
  freed: number;
  over: number;
}): string => {
  if (compacting) {
    return "Compacting conversation…";
  }
  if (freed > 0) {
    return `Freed ${formatTokens(freed)}`;
  }
  if (over > 0) {
    return `Over by ${formatTokens(over)}`;
  }
  return `${formatTokens(free)} left`;
};

const DigitColumn = ({
  char,
  dir,
  reduce,
}: {
  char: string;
  dir: "up" | "down";
  reduce: boolean;
}) => (
  <span className="relative inline-block h-[1em] overflow-hidden align-[-0.05em] leading-none">
    <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="popLayout">
      <motion.span
        animate={{ y: 0 }}
        className="inline-block h-[1em] leading-none"
        exit={{ y: dir === "up" ? "-1em" : "1em" }}
        initial={{ y: dir === "up" ? "1em" : "-1em" }}
        key={char}
        transition={{
          duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.35,
          ease: [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1],
        }}
      >
        {char}
      </motion.span>
    </AnimatePresence>
  </span>
);

const RollingTokens = ({ tokens }: { tokens: number }) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const prevRef = useRef(tokens);
  const [dir, setDir] = useState<"up" | "down">("up");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (prevRef.current === tokens) {
      return;
    }
    setDir(tokens < prevRef.current ? "down" : "up");
    prevRef.current = tokens;
  }, [tokens]);

  const slots = [...formatTokens(tokens)].map((char, position) => ({
    char,
    id: `col-${position}`,
  }));

  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-baseline">
      {slots.map((slot) => (
        <DigitColumn
          char={slot.char}
          dir={dir}
          key={slot.id}
          reduce={Boolean(reduce)}
        />
      ))}
    </span>
  );
};

const ActionButton = ({
  slot,
  variant,
  disabled,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  slot: string;
  variant: "ghost" | "primary";
  disabled?: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  children: string;
}) => (
  <button
    className={cn(
      "relative z-0 inline-flex h-6 cursor-pointer items-center rounded-full border-0 px-2.5 text-xs leading-none font-medium transition-transform duration-150 ease-out after:absolute after:inset-x-0 after:-inset-y-2 after:content-[''] focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none active:enabled:scale-[0.96] disabled:cursor-default disabled:opacity-50 motion-reduce:transition-none dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80",
      "before:absolute before:inset-0 before:-z-1 before:rounded-full before:transition-colors before:duration-150 before:ease-out before:content-['']",
      variant === "ghost" &&
        "text-card-foreground before:bg-foreground/6 hover:enabled:before:bg-foreground/10",
      variant === "primary" &&
        "text-primary-foreground before:bg-primary hover:enabled:before:bg-primary/90"
    )}
    data-slot={slot}
    disabled={disabled}
    onClick={onClick}
    type="button"
  >
    {children}
  </button>
);

const ContextWindowField = ({
  active,
  cells,
  className,
  cellClassName,
  columns,
  compactingSegment,
  label,
  onActiveChange,
}: {
  active: ActiveTarget | null;
  cells: readonly (ContextWindowCell | null)[];
  className?: string;
  cellClassName?: string;
  columns: number | undefined;
  compactingSegment: string | null;
  label: string;
  onActiveChange: (target: ActiveTarget | null) => void;
}) => {
  const step = cells.length > 0 ? SWEEP_MS / cells.length : 0;
  const onPointerOver = (event: PointerEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    const { target } = event;
    // The gaps between cells belong to the field itself. Crossing one keeps
    // the current highlight, so moving along a segment does not flicker.
    if (!(target instanceof HTMLElement) || target === event.currentTarget) {
      return;
    }
    const { item, segment } = target.dataset;
    onActiveChange(segment ? { item, segment } : null);
  };
  return (
    <div
      aria-label={label}
      className={cn(
        "grid gap-0.5 rounded-lg bg-muted p-2 dark:bg-background",
        columns === undefined && AUTO_COLUMNS,
        className
      )}
      data-slot="context-window-field"
      onPointerLeave={() => {
        onActiveChange(null);
      }}
      onPointerOver={onPointerOver}
      role="img"
      style={
        columns === undefined
          ? undefined
          : { gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${columns}, minmax(0, 1fr))` }
      }
    >
      {cells.map((cell, index) => {
        const delay = `${Math.round(index * step)}ms`;
        const pulsing = cell !== null && cell.segment === compactingSegment;
        return (
          <span
            className={cn(
              "aspect-square rounded-[2px] transition-[background-color,opacity] delay-[var(--context-window-delay),0ms] duration-[300ms,150ms] ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
              cell?.kind === "reserved" ? HATCH : "bg-(--context-window-cell)",
              !isLit(cell, active) && "opacity-25",
              pulsing && "animate-pulse motion-reduce:animate-none",
              cellClassName
            )}
            data-item={cell?.item}
            data-kind={cell?.kind ?? "free"}
            data-segment={cell?.segment}
            data-slot="context-window-cell"
            // oxlint-disable-next-line react/no-array-index-key -- cells are positions in a fixed grid
            key={index}
            style={
              // SAFETY: custom properties are valid CSS; CSSProperties omits `--*` keys.
              {
                "--context-window-cell": cell
                  ? KIND_COLOR[cell.kind]
                  : "var(--context-window-free)",
                "--context-window-delay": delay,
                animationDelay: pulsing ? delay : undefined,
              } as CSSProperties
            }
          />
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
};

const Swatch = ({ kind }: { kind: ContextWindowKind }) => (
  <span
    aria-hidden="true"
    className={cn(
      "size-2 flex-none rounded-[2px]",
      kind === "reserved" ? HATCH : "bg-(--context-window-cell)"
    )}
    style={
      // SAFETY: custom properties are valid CSS; CSSProperties omits `--*` keys.
      { "--context-window-cell": KIND_COLOR[kind] } as CSSProperties
    }
  />
);

const ROW_CLASS =
  "flex h-7 w-full min-w-0 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border-0 bg-transparent px-1.5 text-left text-[13px] leading-4 text-card-foreground transition-colors duration-150 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none";

const ContextWindowItemRow = ({
  active,
  className,
  item,
  kind,
  onActiveChange,
  onRemove,
  segment,
}: {
  active: boolean;
  className?: string;
  item: ContextWindowItem;
  kind: ContextWindowKind;
  onActiveChange: (target: ActiveTarget | null) => void;
  onRemove?: (itemId: string, row: HTMLLIElement | null) => void;
  segment: ContextWindowSegment;
}) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const rowRef = useRef<HTMLLIElement>(null);
  const target = { item: item.id, segment: segment.id };
  return (
    <motion.li
      animate={{ height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
      className="overflow-hidden"
      data-slot="context-window-item"
      exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
      initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
      ref={rowRef}
      transition={{ duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.2, ease: [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1] }}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          "group/item flex h-6 min-w-0 items-center gap-0.5 rounded-md pr-1.5 text-xs leading-4 transition-colors duration-150 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
          active && "bg-foreground/6",
          className
        )}
        onBlur={() => {
          onActiveChange(null);
        }}
        onFocus={() => {
          onActiveChange(target);
        }}
        onPointerEnter={() => {
          onActiveChange(target);
        }}
        onPointerLeave={() => {
          onActiveChange(null);
        }}
      >
        <span className="relative flex size-5 flex-none items-center justify-center">
          <span
            aria-hidden="true"
            className={cn(
              "size-1 rounded-full bg-(--context-window-cell) transition-opacity duration-150 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
              onRemove &&
                "group-focus-within/item:opacity-0 group-hover/item:opacity-0 pointer-coarse:opacity-0"
            )}
            style={
              // SAFETY: custom properties are valid CSS; CSSProperties omits `--*` keys.
              { "--context-window-cell": KIND_COLOR[kind] } as CSSProperties
            }
          />
          {onRemove ? (
            <button
              aria-label={`Remove ${item.label}`}
              className="absolute inset-0.5 flex cursor-pointer items-center justify-center rounded-[4px] border-0 bg-transparent p-0 text-muted-foreground opacity-0 transition-[opacity,background-color,color,transform] duration-150 ease-out group-hover/item:opacity-100 after:absolute after:-inset-1 after:content-[''] hover:bg-foreground/10 hover:text-card-foreground focus-visible:opacity-100 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none active:scale-[0.96] motion-reduce:transition-none dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80 pointer-coarse:opacity-100"
              data-slot="context-window-remove"
              onClick={() => {
                onRemove(item.id, rowRef.current);
              }}
              type="button"
            >
              <HugeiconsIcon
                aria-hidden="true"
                className="size-3"
                icon={Cancel01Icon}
                strokeWidth={2}
              />
            </button>
          ) : null}
        </span>
        <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-muted-foreground group-hover/item:text-card-foreground">
          {item.label}
        </span>
        <span className="flex-none text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
          {tokensLabel(item.tokens, segment.approximate)}
        </span>
      </div>
    </motion.li>
  );
};

const ContextWindowRow = ({
  active,
  classNames,
  onActiveChange,
  onRemoveItem,
  onToggle,
  open,
  segment,
}: {
  active: ActiveTarget | null;
  classNames?: ContextWindowClassNames;
  onActiveChange: (target: ActiveTarget | null) => void;
  onRemoveItem?: (segmentId: string, itemId: string) => void;
  onToggle: () => void;
  open: boolean;
  segment: ContextWindowSegment;
}) => {
  const reduce = useReducedMotion();
  const toggleRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const kind = contextWindowKind(segment);
  const items = segment.items ?? [];
  const lit = active?.segment === segment.id && active.item === undefined;
  const target = { segment: segment.id };
  const content = (
    <>
      <Swatch kind={kind} />
      <span className="min-w-0 truncate">{segment.label}</span>
      {items.length > 0 ? (
        <HugeiconsIcon
          aria-hidden="true"
          className={cn(
            "size-3 flex-none text-muted-foreground transition-transform duration-150 ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none",
            open ? "rotate-0" : "-rotate-90"
          )}
          icon={ArrowDown01Icon}
          strokeWidth={2}
        />
      ) : null}
      <span className="ml-auto flex-none text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
        {tokensLabel(segmentTokens(segment), segment.approximate)}
      </span>
    </>
  );
  const removeItem = onRemoveItem
    ? (itemId: string, row: HTMLLIElement | null) => {
        const sibling = row?.nextElementSibling ?? row?.previousElementSibling;
        const next = sibling?.querySelector<HTMLButtonElement>(
          "[data-slot=context-window-remove]"
        );
        (next ?? toggleRef.current)?.focus();
        onRemoveItem(segment.id, itemId);
      }
    : undefined;
  return (
    <li
      className="flex min-w-0 flex-col"
      data-kind={kind}
      data-slot="context-window-segment"
    >
      {items.length > 0 ? (
        <button
          aria-expanded={open}
          className={cn(
            ROW_CLASS,
            "cursor-pointer hover:bg-foreground/6 focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 focus-visible:outline-none dark:focus-visible:ring-ring/80",
            lit && "bg-foreground/6",
            classNames?.row
          )}
          onBlur={() => {
            onActiveChange(null);
          }}
          onClick={onToggle}
          onFocus={() => {
            onActiveChange(target);
          }}
          onPointerEnter={() => {
            onActiveChange(target);
          }}
          onPointerLeave={() => {
            onActiveChange(null);
          }}
          ref={toggleRef}
          type="button"
        >
          {content}
        </button>
      ) : (
        <div
          className={cn(ROW_CLASS, lit && "bg-foreground/6", classNames?.row)}
          onPointerEnter={() => {
            onActiveChange(target);
          }}
          onPointerLeave={() => {
            onActiveChange(null);
          }}
        >
          {content}
        </div>
      )}
      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {open && items.length > 0 ? (
          <motion.ul
            animate={{ height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
            className="m-0 flex list-none flex-col overflow-hidden p-0"
            exit={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            initial={{ height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            key="items"
            transition={{ duration: reduce ? 0 : 0.2, ease: [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1] }}
          >
            <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
              {items.map((item) => (
                <ContextWindowItemRow
                  active={
                    active?.segment === segment.id && active.item === item.id
                  }
                  className={classNames?.item}
                  item={item}
                  key={item.id}
                  kind={kind}
                  onActiveChange={onActiveChange}
                  onRemove={removeItem}
                  segment={segment}
                />
              ))}
            </AnimatePresence>
          </motion.ul>
        ) : null}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </li>
  );
};

/** Tracks a compaction and how many tokens it gave back. */
const useCompaction = ({
  compacting,
  onCompact,
  used,
}: {
  compacting: boolean | undefined;
  onCompact: (() => void | Promise<void>) | undefined;
  used: number;
}) => {
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [freedFrom, setFreedFrom] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const baseline = useRef<number | null>(null);
  const isCompacting = compacting ?? pending;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (isCompacting) {
      baseline.current ??= used;
      return;
    }
    if (baseline.current === null) {
      return;
    }
    setFreedFrom(baseline.current);
    baseline.current = null;
  }, [isCompacting, used]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (freedFrom === null) {
      return;
    }
    const timer = setTimeout(() => {
      setFreedFrom(null);
    }, FREED_MS);
    return () => {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    };
  }, [freedFrom]);

  const compact = async () => {
    if (!onCompact || isCompacting) {
      return;
    }
    setPending(true);
    try {
      await onCompact();
    } finally {
      setPending(false);
    }
  };

  return {
    compact,
    freed: freedFrom === null ? 0 : Math.max(0, freedFrom - used),
    isCompacting,
  };
};

export const ContextWindow = ({
  segments = DEFAULT_SEGMENTS,
  maxTokens = DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS,
  model,
  title = "Context window",
  cells: cellCount = DEFAULT_CELLS,
  columns,
  warnAt = DEFAULT_WARN_AT,
  defaultOpen,
  onRemoveItem,
  onCompact,
  compacting,
  compactLabel = "Compact",
  onClear,
  clearLabel = "Clear",
  className,
  classNames,
  style,
}: ContextWindowProps) => {
  const [active, setActive] = useState<ActiveTarget | null>(null);
  const [closed, setClosed] = useState<ReadonlySet<string>>(() => {
    if (!defaultOpen) {
      return new Set();
    }
    return new Set(
      segments
        .filter((segment) => !defaultOpen.includes(segment.id))
        .map((segment) => segment.id)
    );
  });
  const { free, max, over, ratio, used } = contextWindowTotals(
    segments,
    maxTokens
  );
  const { compact, freed, isCompacting } = useCompaction({
    compacting,
    onCompact,
    used,
  });
  const cells = contextWindowCells(segments, maxTokens, cellCount);
  const conversation = segments.find(
    (segment) => contextWindowKind(segment) === "conversation"
  );
  const canCompact = Boolean(conversation && segmentTokens(conversation) > 0);
  const warn = ratio >= warnAt;
  const summary = `${formatTokens(used)} of ${formatTokens(max)} tokens used, ${percentLabel(ratio)}`;

  const toggle = (id: string) => {
    setClosed((current) => {
      const next = new Set(current);
      if (next.has(id)) {
        next.delete(id);
      } else {
        next.add(id);
      }
      return next;
    });
  };

  return (
    <section
      aria-label={title}
      className={cn(
        THEME_VARS,
        "@container/context-window flex w-full max-w-full min-w-0 flex-col gap-3 rounded-2xl bg-card p-3 text-card-foreground shadow-(--context-window-shadow) transition-shadow duration-150 ease-out hover:shadow-(--context-window-shadow-hover)",
        className,
        classNames?.root
      )}
      data-slot="context-window"
      data-state={isCompacting ? "compacting" : "idle"}
      style={style}
    >
      <div
        className={cn(
          ENTER_CLASS,
          "flex h-6 min-w-0 items-center gap-2",
          classNames?.header
        )}
        data-slot="context-window-header"
      >
        <span className="inline-flex size-6 flex-none items-center justify-center rounded-md bg-(--context-window-icon-bg)">
          <HugeiconsIcon
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="size-3.5 text-(--context-window-conversation)"
            icon={CpuIcon}
            strokeWidth={2}
          />
        </span>
        <div className="max-w-[60%] flex-none truncate text-[13px] leading-tight font-medium tracking-[-0.01em]">
          {title}
        </div>
        {model ? (
          <span
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-right text-xs leading-4 text-muted-foreground"
            data-slot="context-window-model"
          >
            {model}
          </span>
        ) : null}
      </div>

      <div className={cn(ENTER_CLASS, "flex flex-col gap-3 delay-100")}>
        <div
          className={cn(
            "flex min-w-0 items-baseline gap-1.5 pl-0.5",
            classNames?.summary
          )}
          data-slot="context-window-summary"
        >
          <span className="text-2xl leading-none font-medium tracking-tight tabular-nums">
            <RollingTokens tokens={used} />
          </span>
          <span className="text-[13px] leading-none text-muted-foreground tabular-nums">
            / {formatTokens(max)}
          </span>
          <span
            className={cn(
              "ml-auto text-[13px] leading-none font-medium tabular-nums",
              warn ? "text-destructive" : "text-muted-foreground"
            )}
            data-slot="context-window-percent"
          >
            {percentLabel(ratio)}
          </span>
        </div>

        <ContextWindowField
          active={active}
          cellClassName={classNames?.cell}
          cells={cells}
          className={classNames?.field}
          columns={columns}
          compactingSegment={isCompacting ? (conversation?.id ?? null) : null}
          label={summary}
          onActiveChange={setActive}
        />

        <ul
          className={cn(
            "m-0 flex list-none flex-col gap-px p-0",
            classNames?.legend
          )}
          data-slot="context-window-legend"
        >
          {segments.map((segment) => (
            <ContextWindowRow
              active={active}
              classNames={classNames}
              key={segment.id}
              onActiveChange={setActive}
              onRemoveItem={onRemoveItem}
              onToggle={() => {
                toggle(segment.id);
              }}
              open={!closed.has(segment.id)}
              segment={segment}
            />
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>

      <div
        className={cn(
          ENTER_CLASS,
          "flex min-h-6 min-w-0 items-center gap-2 delay-200",
          classNames?.footer
        )}
        data-slot="context-window-footer"
      >
        <output
          aria-live="polite"
          className={cn(
            "min-w-0 flex-1 truncate pl-0.5 text-xs leading-4 tabular-nums",
            over > 0 && !isCompacting && freed === 0
              ? "text-destructive"
              : "text-muted-foreground"
          )}
          data-slot="context-window-status"
        >
          {statusLabel({ compacting: isCompacting, free, freed, over })}
        </output>
        {onClear || onCompact ? (
          <div className="flex flex-none items-center gap-1.5">
            {onClear ? (
              <ActionButton
                disabled={isCompacting}
                onClick={onClear}
                slot="context-window-clear"
                variant="ghost"
              >
                {clearLabel}
              </ActionButton>
            ) : null}
            {onCompact ? (
              <ActionButton
                disabled={isCompacting || !canCompact}
                onClick={() => {
                  void compact();
                }}
                slot="context-window-compact"
                variant="primary"
              >
                {compactLabel}
              </ActionButton>
            ) : null}
          </div>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
};
